name: track_pose
description: Hand or body landmarks through a video, on the device: per frame, 21 per hand (wrist, then each finger from its base joint to its tip) or 33 for one body (face, arms, hands, legs and feet), in source pixels and in metres. A hand or body is tracked from frame to frame; the detector looks again only while fewer are tracked than asked for. Frame i is the frame on screen at i / fps s; HDR clips are tone-mapped to SDR first. The JSON is large (every landmark of every frame): for clips longer than a few seconds pass out, or _project to save it in the project's assets, and read the file. The first run downloads the models: about 8 MB for hand, 9 MB for body.

output.description: { kind, fps, frameCount, size: [w, h], found: frames with a hand or person, frames: [{ t, hands: [{ id (kept while tracked), handedness: left | right, score, landmarks: [[x, y, z] x 21] in source px (z relative to the wrist, the scale of x), world: [[x, y, z] x 21] in metres }] } for hand, or { t, people: [{ id, score, landmarks: [[x, y, z, visibility] x 33] in source px (z relative to the hips' centre), world: [[x, y, z] x 33] in metres }] } for body], model, notes, dropped (only if one had non-finite values: [{ t, id }], left out of its frame) }, or with out the path of that JSON

params.name: fps
params.description: Frames per second to sample, at most the video's own. Default: the video's, at most 30.

params.name: max-frames
params.description: Refuse, before reading it, a clip that samples to more frames than this. Pass a lower fps for a long clip.

params.name: people
params.description: body: most people per frame. 1 for now: the body model follows one person.

params.name: pad
params.description: Black border around the frame for the detector, as a fraction of the long side. Default: 0.3333 for hand, which finds hands that fill the frame or leave it; 0 for body.

params.name: min-presence
params.description: Lowest score, 0 to 1, at which a detection, a hand or a body counts as found. Lower finds more, and more wrong ones.

params.name: smooth
params.description: one-euro: a One Euro filter per hand or body on landmarks and world. none: raw.

params.name: min-cutoff
params.description: One Euro cutoff in Hz for a still hand or body. Lower is smoother.

params.name: beta
params.description: One Euro: how much the cutoff rises with the speed. Higher lags less.

params.name: out
params.description: Write the JSON here and print its path
